what: Two photo slots are pinned to one side (the first photo + the tall Section name) while a block of text passes beside them. The text block fades out and blurs to 4px from when its center reaches the screen center until its bottom edge reaches the top of the screen. Until the second text fully enters from the bottom of the screen, the second photo fills up from below with clip-path while the first Section name blurs out and the second Section name sharpens. When the top of the second slot reaches the top of the screen, is-change is added to the panel to change the stage color (original navy → dark green, 1s). It is bound directly to scroll position with no curve

options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Second photo (child) that fills up from below — the sticky slot (position: sticky) is the consumer’s css
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Text chunks that fade as they pass (multiple)
options.[data-key=drive]: (one of the fades) Text that drives the fill-up — if absent, the last fade
options.[data-fx-part=label-a] · [data-fx-part=l: (if present) names of the first and second sheets — they blur out and clear up along with the fill-up
options.[data-fx-part=switch]: (if present) slot that adds a class to the panel when its top edge touches the top of the screen
